context: "After all, time is a key ingredient of my profession," states Francis Kéré in his book Francis Kéré: Building Stories . Architecture is constantly evolving and transforming over time. Bricks, doors, windows, walls, stairs, and other elements become the protagonists of a process

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: "After all, time is a key ingredient of my profession," states Francis Kéré in his book Francis Kéré: Building Stories . Architecture is constantly evolving and transforming over time. Bricks, doors, windows, walls, stairs, and other elements become the protagonists of a process that begins with a sketch and eventually takes shape as a built work.
